classification.difficultyReason: Identify exposed surfaces, exclude internal joins, find a cone's slant height and account for a hemispherical cavity.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of each object.

spec.description: A hemisphere caps a cylinder. The cylinder is 12 cm high and its lower circular base has diameter 10 cm. Rear arcs are dashed and the join centre is marked. The lower base remains exterior.
spec.mathematics: Common radius 5 cm; exposed area is the curved hemisphere, curved cylinder and lower circular base.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source measurements are visible.

answer.worked:
The common radius is $10\div2=5\text{ cm}$. Include the lower circular base; the joined circular faces are internal.

$\begin{aligned}S&=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh+\pi r^2\\S&=2\pi(5)^2+2\pi(5)(12)+\pi(5)^2\\S&=50\pi+120\pi+25\pi\\S&=195\pi\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$

spec.description: A hemisphere joins an inverted cone along their common circular base. Overall height is 17 cm and cone height is 12 cm. The join has a dashed rear arc and marked centre.
spec.mathematics: Hemisphere radius is 17 minus 12; cone slant height follows from its radius and perpendicular height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only overall height 17 cm and cone height 12 cm are supplied.

answer.short:
$115\pi\text{ cm}^2$

Add the two curved surface areas; their circular join is internal.
answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}r&=17-12\\r&=5\text{ cm}\\\ell^2&=5^2+12^2\\\ell^2&=169\\\ell&=13\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$

The circular join is internal.

$\begin{aligned}S&=2\pi r^2+\pi r\ell\\S&=2\pi(5)^2+\pi(5)(13)\\S&=50\pi+65\pi\\S&=115\pi\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$

spec.description: A 10 cm by 10 cm by 6 cm rectangular prism contains a hemispherical cavity opening in its top. The opening diameter is 8 cm. The elliptical rim and centre are shown; hidden prism edges and the cavity profile are dashed.
spec.mathematics: Remove a radius-4 circular area from the prism surface and add the radius-4 curved hemispherical cavity area.
spec.answerVisibility: Only prism dimensions and opening diameter are visible.

answer.short:
$(440+16\pi)\text{ cm}^2$

Subtract the circular opening from the prism's surface area, then add the curved cavity.
answer.worked:
The cavity radius is $8\div2=4\text{ cm}$.

$\begin{aligned}A_{\text{prism}}&=2(10\times10+10\times6+10\times6)\\A_{\text{prism}}&=440\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$

Subtract the circular opening and add the curved hemisphere.

$\begin{aligned}S&=440-\pi r^2+2\pi r^2\\S&=440-\pi(4)^2+2\pi(4)^2\\S&=(440+16\pi)\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$
